name: Thunderous Voice
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 min./level (D)

DESCRIPTION

Your voice is amplified greatly. Subtract 10 from Perception check DCs to hear you speaking or whispering, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Intimidate checks.

While the spell is active you can shout as a swift action dealing 1d8 sonic damage in a 15-foot cone. Creatures that take damage must also make a Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 round. Using this action discharges the spell.

Creatures that cannot hear are not stunned but still take the sonic damage. This spell cannot pass through an area of silence.
